items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: when I would go to school Sam basically said okay we’ve got History of Music first period... he would let me stay in the back of the music room and just sleep on a desk.

ctx.x: All the cats, yeah, I mean that was one hell of a band. And then “Take Five,” you know the “Time Out” album. That was the other one that I got. And then we just started buying a whole bunch of things and of course we had this whole entourage of Sinatra albums. And when you’re listening to Nelson Riddle and Duke Ellington and all this stuff, I mean you’re catching the vibe of exactly what this is about. And then I just started, there used to be a label, Premier, which as I found out later exploited all of the cats…
